title: fix(spec): a view container's `form` is its default form — never collapsed into a named form, and no named form is promoted
body:
Fixes #21500
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`ViewSchema` declares `form` a view container's **default form** and `formViews` **additional named form views**. `expandViewContainerWithDiagnostics` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`), the one expansion every view registrar shares (ObjectQL boot loop, metadata artifact/HMR loader, runtime expansion in `metadata-protocol`), now serves exactly that. This executes triage's ruling of record on the card (Q1 A, Q2 A):

- **Form family.** The `{ type, label, columns }` signature de-duplication (`formSigSeen`) is gone. The container's `form` is always served as its own item, `OBJECT.form`, flagged `isDefault`, and it is the only form item flagged. A named form whose body equals `form` stays its own named item.
- **No `form`, no default form.** The first-named promotion (`isDefault` stamped on `out[formStart]`) is gone. A container with no `form` serves every named form by name, with no `isDefault` key, the same spelling the list family uses for "not default".
- **List family, folded in (same function, same signature helper).** The default `list` used to collapse into any named list sharing its `{ type, label, columns }`, so a named list with a different body (a filter, a sort) took the default's place and the default list's own body was not served. It now collapses only into a named list that restates its whole body, the view's own `name` aside, which is the "default == `listViews.all`" pattern the collapse exists for. A named list that differs in anything else is its own view, and `list` is served beside it as the default.

The example containers whose create/edit form lived in `formViews` move it into `form`. The public Web-to-Lead and contact-us forms stay named. ⛔ No serve-path, `metadata-protocol`, `objectql` or console change.

## In-repo containers whose served form family changed

Measured by running the pure function over all 11 in-repo `defineView` containers (`examples/**`, `packages/qa/downstream-contract`; `packages/apps/**` holds none), before (spec `dist` built at `88fb5e85a0`) and after (this branch). `*` marks the `isDefault` item. The list family is unchanged in all 11.

| Container | Before | After | Intent, read from the container's own text |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crm_activity` (app-crm) | `default*` | `form*` | `formViews.default`, the only form, keyed `default`. Moved into `form`. |
| `crm_lead` (app-crm) | `web_to_lead*`, `default` | `web_to_lead`, `form*` | `default` is the full lead form. `web_to_lead`'s docblock: "PUBLIC / ANONYMOUS — Web-to-Lead", hosted at `/forms/contact-us`. `default` moved into `form`; `web_to_lead` stays named. |
| `crm_opportunity` (app-crm) | `default*` | `form*` | As `crm_activity`. |
| `showcase_business_unit` | `edit*` | `form*` | Its comment: "`edit`, not `default`: the main `list` implicitly claims OBJECT.default ... so a `default` form key collides". Intended as the default; moved. |
| `showcase_project` | `edit*` | `form*` | Same comment; moved. |
| `showcase_task` | `edit*`, `tabbed`, `wizard`, `split`, `quick` | `tabbed`, `wizard`, `split`, `quick`, `form*` | Same comment ("Keyed `edit`, NOT `default`"); moved. `showcase_log_time`, `showcase_new_task` and the Overview page's Create Task button now target `showcase_task.form`. |
| `showcase_inquiry` | `contact*` | `contact` | `contact` is the PUBLIC anonymous web-to-lead form (docblock, `sharing.allowAnonymous`, `publicLink`). Not a create/edit form, so it stays named and the container has no default form. No source change. |
| `showcase_contact` | `create*` | `create`, `form*` | Already authors `form` (the documented create-vs-edit pattern in `content/docs/ui/create-vs-edit-form.mdx`). No source change; now served as documented. |

For every migrated container the default form's body is the body that was `isDefault` before, so create/edit render the same form; `crm_lead` and `showcase_contact` change to the form their authors declared.

Companion edits the move needs: `examples/app-crm/test/i18n-sections.test.ts` walks the default `form` as well as `formViews` (otherwise moving the forms silently dropped 8 of its 9 sections from coverage, and its non-vacuity guard would have read 1); the showcase coverage collector counts the default `form`'s type, symmetric with the list collector; the app-crm translation comments and two platform-checklist strings name the new identities. `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` taught a container whose only form was `formViews.edit`, which after this change declares no default form; it now teaches `form` as the default and `formViews` as named forms served by name. `create-vs-edit-form.mdx` already describes what is served.

## The list family and the `default_2` reading

- **Falsifying case, before:** `list: { type: grid, label: 'All Leads', columns: [name, company] }` beside `listViews.mine` with the same three keys plus a `filter`. The default list was collapsed into `mine`: one item, `crm_lead.mine`, flagged default, and the default list (no filter) was not served. **After:** `crm_lead.mine` (named, not default) and `crm_lead.default` (default, no filter). Pinned.
- **Identical restatement:** app-crm's `list` restates `listViews.all` key for key in a different key order; it still collapses into `all` in all three app-crm containers (scan above). Pinned, including the case where only the list's own `name` differs.
- **`default` renamed `default_2` on app-crm:** not reproduced at `88fb5e85a0`. With the pure function and with the composed app-crm stack, `crm_lead`'s `formViews.default` was served as `crm_lead.default` with zero collisions, because the default `list` collapses into `listViews.all` and leaves `crm_lead.default` free. The rename mechanism itself (a nameless default `list` claims `OBJECT.default`, a later `formViews.default` is renamed `OBJECT.default_2` and reported as a collision) is a different rule: the shared name space, not the signature or the default promotion. It survives this change and is already loud (rename warning, `collisions`, `os lint`). After the migration no app-crm container has a `formViews.default`.

## Measurements

- **Door probe** (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/view-container-default-form.dogfood.test.ts`, the `domain:engine` seat's commits brought in unchanged): green at HEAD (3 passed): the HotCRM shape, the two-form shape and the `crm_account` control. Its expectations are untouched.
- **Real HotCRM container** (hotcrm `0b2a9d4`, `src/sales/views/lead.view.ts`, 7 named forms), through this branch's spec `dist`: `crm_lead.form` is served with its six sections and is the only `isDefault`; the seven named forms are served by name, none default.
- **Overlay re-measure (unscoped kernel, `@objectstack/verify` `bootStack`, real HTTP):** packaged `crm_contact` = `form` + `formViews.detail_form`. `PUT /meta/view/crm_contact` (200) with the HotCRM shape (`form` + `detail_form` + `web_to_lead`) now serves `crm_contact.detail_form` (order 0, not default), `crm_contact.web_to_lead` (1, not default), `crm_contact.form` (2, **default**, the overlay's own sections). One default form; before this change the same overlay served two. A second overlay, of `crm_account`, authoring named forms and no `form`, serves `crm_account.detail_form`, the packaged `crm_account.form` (still the one default) and `crm_account.web_to_lead`. One default. NOT MEASURED on `env_local`: the session's permission policy refused setting up the CLI standalone-stack driver.
- **What the console does with a container that has no `form`:** objectui's merge rule at the `.objectui-sha` pin (`applyViewItem`: `if (view.isDefault || !bucket.form) bucket.form = entry;`), run verbatim on this branch's rows, still makes `showcase_inquiry.contact` the console's `.form`: the first form item, with no `isDefault`. `crm_lead` and `showcase_contact` resolve to their `form`. Recorded in Acceptance notes.

## Ablation

The `formSigSeen` de-duplication alone re-planted (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode; anchor 1 → 0, blob `5053b26a8f` → `8cc32810e7`), spec rebuilt, `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` marker present in 6 built files:
- the spec pins: 2 failed, 3 passed (the HotCRM collision shape and the named-form-equals-`form` case);
- the door probe: 1 failed, 2 passed (the HotCRM shape, `crm_lead.form` missing; the two-form and control cases stay green).

Restored by blob (`5053b26a8f` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, tree clean), spec rebuilt, preflight `--absent` over 228 built files: pins 5/5 and probe 3/3 green. Run at `78f36c0ebb`; the form family is byte-identical at HEAD.

## Tests updated, and why

- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/engine-nested-plugin-view-expansion.test.ts`, `scripts/codemod/view-to-viewitem.mjs`: comments only. They stated the old `{ type, label, columns }` collapse rule; their fixtures and assertions are unchanged and green.
- `examples/app-showcase/test/actions.test.ts`: the two `target` assertions follow the task form's move to `showcase_task.form`.
- No test was found pinning the defect itself. The lint fixture whose default list differs from `listViews.all` only by the list's own `name` is what decided that `name` is identity, not body.

## Gates

All readings below are at HEAD `3fa9e55aed`.

- **Derived set:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 132 commands; all 132 run with the exit code recorded before any pipe; `--ran`: "132 derived, 132 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Two first answered exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (`check:skill-examples` reads `@objectstack/client-react`'s declarations; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reads 8 packages outside this diff's build closure). Those packages were built and both re-ran to exit 0.
- **Release level:** `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, with this body as the `--event` payload: "This diff introduces no `major` bump." and "LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `no`". `check-adr-0087-registration`: "this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset (1 non-breaking changeset(s) seen)". `check-empty-changeset`: "1 declaring changeset(s) added".
- **`@objectstack/spec`:** `build`; `check:generated` ("All 15 generated artifacts are up to date"); `typecheck` (tsc, scripts, test layer); the `local` suite, 604 files / 17844 tests passed; the three view-related `repo`-project files, 64 tests passed. No generated artifact changed.
- **Consumers of the expansion** (each package's test files that read it): `metadata` 52, `metadata-protocol` 217, `objectql` 46, `rest` 76, `lint` 686, `metadata-core` 27, `cli` unit 81. All passed.
- **Example apps:** `@objectstack/example-crm` typecheck, plus 45 tests (the i18n sweep now lists the 8 moved `form` sections); `@objectstack/example-showcase` typecheck, plus 394 tests. **Dogfood:** the door probe 3/3; the two showcase-booting view and public-form tests 6/6.
- **Declared, not run here:** the full lint-workflow farm, `pnpm lint`, the CLI integration tier and the full dogfood suite are CI's.
- **Stale tree, declared:** at HEAD the branch is 6 commits behind `origin/main` (`550f4cc2fd`). Two gate-config files changed there: the doc-authoring prose-id baseline (shrunk by the spec strings stage) and the engine-double pin list. This diff feeds neither family: no runtime string here carries a tracker id, and no engine double is added. CI judges the merge ref.

## Acceptance notes

- **objectui still promotes the first named form for a container with no `form`** (measured above, `showcase_inquiry`). The spec no longer flags it; the console's `!bucket.form` fallback does. Filed as objectstack-ai/objectui#11539; no console change here.
- **The published `objectstack-ui` skill** (`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` subforms example, `rules/list-views.md` container example and its eval) teaches the create/edit form under `formViews.default` / `formViews.edit`. After this change those forms are named, not default. `skills/**` is a Tier H surface, so it is left out of this PR. It is carded as #21537 (seat answer `5965506932`, option A), to ship in the same release.
- **A dead read, noted:** the expansion's `form.name` branch (`typeof defaultForm.name === 'string' ? … : 'form'`) reads a key the strict `FormViewSchema` refuses (`unrecognized_keys`), so it is unreachable for schema-valid metadata. It is left as it is.
- **Release:** `@objectstack/spec` `patch` (the expansion is corrected to the declared contract; no accept set changes). The example apps are private.
